name: minimal-rss-test
description: Minimal test: fetch 1 RSS feed, summarize, output

steps.name: fetch-rss
steps.prompt:
Fetch this RSS feed and extract the 5 most recent articles:

URL: https://hnrss.org/frontpage

For each article extract:
- Title
- URL
- Brief summary (1 sentence)

Return as a clean list.

steps.name: summarize
steps.prompt:
Create a short summary from these articles:

{{articles}}

Format:
```
📰 **Mini RSS Test**

• [Title] — 1 sentence summary *(Source)*
• [Title] — 1 sentence summary *(Source)*
• [Title] — 1 sentence summary *(Source)*

*OpenFang minimal test*
```

Keep under 500 characters.
